steps.observation: You have 300 seconds. What are three strategies for reducing carbon emissions in cities?

steps.action:
Here are three high-impact strategies for cutting urban carbon emissions:

1. Sustainable Transportation  
   • Expand and electrify public transit (buses, trams, subways)  
   • Build safe bike lanes and pedestrian zones to shift short trips out of cars  
   • Incentivize electric-vehicle charging infrastructure and low-emission ride-share fleets  

2. Green Buildings & Energy Efficiency  
   • Adopt stringent building codes (better insulation, high-efficiency HVAC, LED lighting)  
   • Retrofit existing commercial and residential stock with smart thermostats, window upgrades, heat pumps  
   • Offer subsidies or low-interest loans for energy audits and deep-efficiency upgrades  

3. Low-Carbon Energy Supply  
   • Procure or generate more renewables on the grid (solar farms, wind, hydro)  
   • Facilitate rooftop solar and community microgrids for neighborhoods  
   • Encourage district heating/cooling systems that run on waste heat or renewables rather than fossil fuels
